stimulus: 100 words. 10 Read the passage on 'Training Schedule' and answer questions nos. 4 and 5: A sports club is going to arrange training for the future sportsmen and sportswomen from January next year. Interested young boys and girls between 10 to 15 are invited to take the opportunity. Training on race will be held from January 6 to April 5, on long-jump from February 11 to May 10, on high- jump and pool jump from March 14 to June 13, on gymnastics from May 16 to August I3 and on volley ball, kabadi and badminton from July 21 to October 19. Talented sportsmen and sportswomen will have to pay nothing for the service. But for further three months’ training interested candidates will have to pay Tk. 20,000, Tk. 25,000, Tk. 18,000, Tk. 22,000, Tk. 21,000. Tk. 16,000. Tk. 30,000 and Tk. 24,000 for pool-jump, kabadi, high-jump, volley-ball, badminton,. long-jump, gymnastics and race respectively.
